name: schema-violation-negative-wcet
description: A declared field carrying a value the model schema rejects: `Task.wcet` must be a whole number followed by one of `ns`, `us`, `ms`, `s`, and greater than zero. The protocol admits any JSON as a payload on purpose, so the bound is checked by the registry against `schema.py` over the staged result, not by the request shape.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model. `Task_10ms` declares `wcet: 1200us` — the budget carries its unit, unlike `period`, which is float seconds.

input.intent: Correct the execution-time budget of Task_10ms.

expected.notes: `schema-violation` covers type, bound, enum-member and NaN/±Infinity violations alike. It is the same code a malformed request envelope gets, which is why a `protocol-schema` negative's expectation is pinned to it and this `semantic` one shares it: the code says what was wrong, the `violation_layer` says who is able to notice.
